exact_remaining_clauses.expected_observation: A stopped app resumes after retention expiry — - **GIVEN** local raw bytes expired while the app was stopped - **WHEN** the owner unlocks the workspace - **THEN** expired and unindexed bytes are removed before exposure, failed removal remains pending, no expired read or upload is admitted, and the stopped app makes no exact-time physical cleanup claim.
unproved_then_clauses: “expired while stopped ... owner unlocks ... before exposure, failed removal remains pending, no expired read or upload admitted”: test manually reconciles future expiry BEFORE closing/reopening and never injects removal failure.
